lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs are arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with 4-5 primary nodes visible per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with primary blobs to form a regular grid-like matrix across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on its dorsal aspect to deep shadow on its ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep semi-circular notch or indentation present on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant gradient change in pattern density, transitioning from discrete large blobs on the mid-body to a high-density cluster of micro-spots on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
